description: This file defines a struct and an enum related to device model recognition and presentation, including mapping model identifiers to user-friendly names and icons, and loading resource data for device identifiers.
external_files: Foundation.framework resource files such as ios-device-identifiers.json and mac-device-identifiers.json

classes.name: DevicePresentation
classes.description: A struct representing the presentation details of a device, including title and optional symbol.

methods.name: presentation
methods.description: Returns a DevicePresentation object with a title and symbol based on device family and model identifier.

methods.name: symbol
methods.description: Determines the symbol icon name for a device given its family and model identifier, with optional friendly name.

methods.name: symbolFor
methods.description: Private method that deduces icon name based on model identifier and friendly name.

methods.name: fallbackSymbol
methods.description: Provides a default symbol based on device family if no specific symbol is found.

methods.name: loadModelIdentifierToName
methods.description: Loads and merges device identifier mappings from JSON resource files.

methods.name: loadMapping
methods.description: Loads device identifier to name mapping from a specified resource JSON file.

methods.name: locateResourceBundle
methods.description: Locates the resource bundle containing device identifier JSON files.

methods.name: bundleIfContainsDeviceModels
methods.description: Checks if a bundle contains device model JSON files to identify the correct resource bundle.

methods.name: normalizedName
methods.description: Decodable enum case method to retrieve a trimmed, normalized device name.
